title: Dodge.d20 (effects.py:370) still checks `ctx.kind == "save"` directly. Switch it to `ctx.is_save` so every save effect uses the one predicate. Behaviour stays the same because a death save has no ability.

history.summary: I changed Dodge.d20 (dungdra/effects.py:370) to use `ctx.is_save` instead of `ctx.kind == "save"`, so every save effect now goes through the one predicate. Behaviour stays the same: a death save has no ability, so the `ability == "dex"` check still leaves it out. I added a unit test that checks Dodge gives advantage on a Dex save and not on a Con save, a Dex check or a death save. Unit tests pass (332), ruff check and ruff format --check are clean, and dev-gate passes. The ticket names no acceptance tests, so there were none to run with --runxfail.
